rules: Exactly four fresh independent account paths. Reuse saved zero-cost evidence only; never rerun sealed experiments.
Same fixed98 TRI-excluded conditional domain, calendar, prices, actions, initial capital, fixed seeds, original8192 and continuous32 search budgets in all arms.
Every monthly search uses its own actual cash and marked shares after incurred costs. Align monthly search fee_bps to execution fee_bps; slippage applies only to next-open execution.
BUY open*(1+slippage_bps/10000), SELL open*(1-slippage_bps/10000); fees charged per filled notional on each side. Use existing whole-share cash rationing and action accounting.
Do not copy old monthly targets or subtract a cost estimate from saved NAV. Do not change SMA20 or floor-half rules after outcomes.
The 1bp charge is an aggregate research stress, not a claim about actual HSBC charges. Zero commission does not establish zero slippage.
Freeze reviewed implementation and input hashes before any historical execution. Create-only run directories; preserve failures, no automatic retries or production changes.

acceptance.per_scenario: half exact final_equity >= continuous32 exact final_equity AND half exact maximum_close_drawdown < continuous32 exact maximum_close_drawdown
acceptance.joint: Both fixed scenarios pass per_scenario; otherwise report tradeoffs without changing thresholds or selecting the best scenario.
required_reports: every calendar-year return and drawdown;2026 period only
whole-period CAGR and maximum close drawdown
independent ledger, cost and own-capital monthly checks
